{{Quote|The Mandalorians are in full retreat, General Secura. But unit strength's down to sixty percent.''"<br />"''I know, Commander ''Bly'', but until we get replacements from Kamino, we'll have to make do.|[[Bly/Legends|Bly]] and [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]]|<ref name="Republic 65" />}}
The '''Battle of [[New Holstice/Legends|New Holstice]]''' was a battle of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="GAW" /> which took place in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]]-aligned [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protectors]]<ref name="GAW" /> and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces, including the [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps]],<ref name="gar" /> led by [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|Bly]] and [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]].<ref name="Republic 65" /> Although the battle was a victory for the Republic, ending with the full retreat of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] forces,<ref name="Republic 65" /> the Protectors struck a serious blow,<ref name="GAW" /> bringing the strength of Bly's unit down to sixty percent.<ref name="Republic 65" />

==Behind the scenes==
The aftermath of a battle between Commander Bly's Republic forces and a group of Mandalorians on New Holstice was first depicted in the [[2004]] [[Dark Horse Comics]] issue [[Republic 65|''Republic'' 65]].<ref name="Republic 65" /> The [[2005|following year]], [[Star Wars Insider 84|''Star Wars Insider'' 84's]] article "[[Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic]]" confirmed that the 327th Star Corps, Bly's unit, had fought at New Holstice,<ref name="gar" /> while the [[2009]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] supplement ''[[Galaxy at War]]'' established that the Mandalorian Protectors had fought in the Battle of Holstice.<ref name="GAW" /> This article assumes that the events described in ''Republic'' 65, "Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic", and ''Galaxy at War'' are one and the same.

While ''Republic'' 65 originally established the Battle of New Holstice to have occurred [[21 BBY/Legends|seventeen months after]] the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]],<ref name="Republic 65" /> changes to the timeline of the Clone Wars necessitated by the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (multimedia project)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' multimedia project]] moved the battle back to 22 BBY.<ref name="Date" />
